subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread replies be exposed as a separate `dmThreadMode` account key, folded into existing `replyToMode` or `threadSessions` behavior, or deferred to the broader open thread-session work?
rationale: This PR adds a public config surface and re-enables a delivery mode previously removed for Google Chat API failures, so a maintainer must choose the supported product/API contract before the remaining code fixes are meaningful.

options.title: Hold For API Decision
options.body: Keep this branch blocked until maintainers choose whether `dmThreadMode` is a separate contract or belongs in the broader thread configuration work.

options.title: Accept Separate dmThreadMode
options.body: Allow the default-off key, then require exported types, generated metadata, docs, and inspectable real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Thread Sessions
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96843 or a maintainer-equivalent path as the canonical public surface and close or replace this narrower branch after that path is chosen.

recommendation.title: Hold For API Decision
recommendation.body: Keep this branch blocked until maintainers choose whether `dmThreadMode` is a separate contract or belongs in the broader thread configuration work.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the prior DM thread suppression fix and recent Google Chat thread-support commits, making them the best available owner for the API direction choice.
